**BLUF:** Ukrainian drone strikes expanded to at least two major Russian refineries (Ryazan, Kstovo) in the reporting window, extending a sustained campaign that is measurably tightening Russian fuel supply. Democrats secured majorities in both US House and Senate in the midterms, narrowing the incoming administration’s unilateral foreign-policy options. Limited Hormuz mining and Qeshm strikes keep the Strait contested without major escalation. North Korean tests and European hybrid incidents (EFS blood-service cyber) remain contained but signal ongoing low-cost pressure. No verified movement in quiet theatres after sweep.

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

[OSINT - SOCIAL] Multiple accounts including @WW3finalboss, @front_ukrainian and @thetect0nic (05 Nov ~10:00–16:00 UTC) posted videos and photos of large fires at the Rosneft Ryazan refinery following reported Ukrainian drone strikes.

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @Money_WorldX, @MoloWarMonitor and @truthmatternews (05 Nov ~10:00–16:30 UTC) circulated details of the French EFS blood-service cyberattack via Coolworld contract, noting refrigeration-system disruption but no product loss due to alarms.

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @grok (05 Nov ~10:59 UTC) noted the absence of independent verification for new tanker incidents in the Strait of Hormuz beyond the previously reported Louise 1 limpet-mine strike.

[OSINT - SOCIAL] @AukDok, @Osint_Ghost and @Intelysis (05 Nov ~17:30–18:30 UTC) shared North Korean state-media claims of successful anti-aircraft missile tests paired with cruise-missile drills.

searched: Ryazan refinery drone; Kstovo refinery attack; Qeshm Island strike; North Korea missile test; Nyala Sudan drone strike; EFS blood cyberattack France; Louise 1 tanker Hormuz; Guinea Burkinabe miners

**Assessment:** Social amplification of refinery fires and the French cyber incident is organic and first-hand in the window, outpacing wire copy by hours; Hormuz and North Korean claims remain unverified beyond state or partisan channels (likely, moderate confidence — multiple independent accounts but limited geolocation or third-party confirmation).

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (05 Nov 02:05Z) reported Ukrainian drone strike on Rosneft’s Ryazan oil refinery (~17 Mt/year capacity); governor confirmed fires at industrial sites.

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent and others (04-05 Nov) detailed ongoing Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian refineries including Lukoil’s Kstovo (fourth-largest, ~17 Mt/year) with video evidence of fires.

[OSINT - WEB] Ukrainska Pravda (05 Nov 17:53Z) reported Russian strike on manufacturing facility in Kyiv Oblast injuring two.

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (06 Nov 02:54Z) reported Trump meeting Russian envoy in Washington ahead of Ukraine peace talks, claiming “big, beautiful agreement” coming.

**Assessment:** The refinery campaign is expanding fuel-supply pressure on Russia; sustained tempo raises the risk of visible shortages or export restrictions within weeks (likely, moderate confidence — multiple independent OSINT videos and governor confirmation).

### MIDDLE EAST

[OSINT - WEB] WSJ, CNN, Stars and Stripes (02-05 Nov) confirmed limited US defensive strikes on Qeshm Island air-defense and missile sites in response to Iranian SAM activity.

[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain, Reuters (04 Nov) confirmed Panama-flagged Louise 1 hit by limpet mines ~25 nm NE of Khasab; crew safe, ongoing Hormuz risk.

[OSINT - WEB] Jerusalem Post, Guardian (05 Nov) reported Democrats’ midterm gains and Trump/Vance linking losses to Iran war and fuel costs.

[OSINT - WEB] Al Jazeera (06 Nov) reported Iran’s security chief meeting Putin with message from Khamenei.

**Assessment:** Limited strikes and shipping incidents keep the Strait contested without major escalation; Democratic congressional control narrows Trump’s window for unilateral action before January (roughly even chance, moderate confidence — corroborated by multiple outlets but no new kinetic escalation in window).

### INDO-PACIFIC

[OSINT - WEB] NK News, Taipei Times (05 Nov) reported North Korea fired unidentified projectiles and tested new anti-aircraft missiles plus cruise-missile drills.

[OSINT - WEB] Taipei Times (06 Nov) noted routine PLA activity (low daily aircraft counts).

**Assessment:** North Korean tests are routine signaling rather than a new capability threshold; no median-line surge or major incident reported (quiet in window, high confidence).

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA

No headlines or verified movement in window.

**Assessment:** Quiet in window (high confidence — no coverage in provided feeds after sweep).

### AFRICA

[OSINT - WEB] Africanews (05 Nov) reported Guinea expelling >8,000 Burkinabé gold miners.

**Assessment:** Regional expulsions and court rulings are the main movement; no new verified drone-strike developments in Sudan/Tigray (quiet on priority items, moderate confidence).

### AMERICAS

[OSINT - WEB] Guardian, NPR (05 Nov) reported Democrats securing majorities in House and Senate; Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigned then faced impeachment after bank collapse.

**Assessment:** US midterm results shift congressional oversight on foreign policy; Paraguay crisis is domestic (quiet beyond US results, high confidence).

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE

[OSINT - WEB] Multiple outlets (05 Nov) reported routine space-debris warnings and Chinese military exercises in the window.

**Assessment:** No new missile or counterspace events beyond North Korean tests already covered (quiet in window, high confidence).

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE

[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain (05 Nov) reported IMO backing Dominguez for second term amid shipping attacks.

**Assessment:** Refinery strikes and Hormuz friction are the dominant energy signals; no new sanctions or chokepoint closures (quiet beyond covered items, moderate confidence).

leads worked: 1 of 4 nav warnings carried (Sulu Sea space debris); 3 GDELT hotspots searched and carried (Kstovo, Qeshm/Hormuz, Sudan); 1 passed over (Tigray partial).

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY

[OSINT - WEB] BleepingComputer (04 Nov) reported cyberattack disrupts blood storage refrigeration systems in France (EFS facilities); temperatures altered but alarms prevented loss.

[OSINT - WEB] The Record (04 Nov) reported cyberattack wipes cloud data at Russian hosting provider Beget.

searched: EFS blood cyberattack France (headlines + X)

**Assessment:** Hybrid refrigeration and flight-threat incidents are low-cost, high-visibility but contained by existing safeguards; no confirmed state attribution yet (likely ongoing campaign, moderate confidence).

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE

[OSINT - WEB] Multiple outlets (05 Nov) reported Democrats securing majorities in House and Senate.

**Assessment:** Electoral outcome is the dominant domestic signal; no verified infrastructure incidents beyond routine (quiet on priority items, high confidence).

## 5. UAP/UFO

No official statements, hearings or releases in window.

**Assessment:** Quiet in window (high confidence).

## 6. FRONTIER AND CONSCIOUSNESS RESEARCH

No peer-reviewed publications or funded programme announcements matching criteria in window.

**Assessment:** Quiet in window (high confidence).

## FORECAST CHECK

1. TRIGGERED — Ukrainian refinery strikes on Ryazan and Kstovo reported above with video and governor confirmation.

2. OPEN — Louise 1 limpet-mine strike occurred; no new mining or major Iranian retaliation beyond Qeshm defensive strikes.

3. NOT TRIGGERED — No median-line surge reported; routine low counts only.

4. OPEN — EFS and Beget incidents reported; no state attribution or NATO alert issued.

## INDICATORS AND WARNINGS

- Sustained Ukrainian refinery strikes causing measurable throughput drop → Russian fuel-export curbs or import deals → IEA/Kpler data or Russian statements first → likely in next 48h.
- New limpet-mine or projectile incidents in Hormuz beyond Louise 1 → shipping avoidance spike or insurance-rate jump → UKMTO/insurance notices first → roughly even chance.
- >20 PLA aircraft across Taiwan median line in one day → Taiwan MND or US statement → unlikely.
- Confirmed state attribution for EFS/Beget or similar European hybrid incidents → NATO cyber alert or sanctions → roughly even chance.

## COLLECTION GAPS

No independent confirmation of damage claims or casualty figures at Ryazan/Kstovo beyond Ukrainian and governor statements. No verified attribution for French or Russian cyber incidents. No on-ground reporting from Guinea expulsions or new Hormuz incidents beyond official and OSINT accounts.
